status.scope_reason: The company develops and sells TradeZone, an automated trade finance workflow and processing platform designed specifically for banks and financial institutions.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records fetched from Tracxn, Kyzer Software India Private Limited is active and headquartered in Mumbai, India, while its official product suite outlines TradeZone as its flagship trade finance automation platform.

claims.claim: The company reports that its platform integrates with SWIFT networks, ERP platforms, core banking systems, and regulatory engines like the Reserve Bank of India's EDPMS/IDPMS to support transaction lifecycles and compliance.
The company reports that its platform features an "AI Document Intelligence" engine designed to automatically process trade documents using OCR and AI validation.

The company reports that its TradeZone platform supports transaction movement across third-party compliance applications for AML/TBML and sanction screenings, alongside regulatory compliance modules for KYC and automated regulatory reporting frameworks.

The company reports that its core trade finance platform, TradeZone, offers integration with SWIFT and corporate core banking systems via direct connections, and provides a SWIFT FX Reconciliation Portal for message tracking and exception handling.
The company reports that its platform features API-first integration capabilities to connect seamlessly with SWIFT networks, ERP platforms, and third-party data providers.

The company reports that its banking automation platform is built on a modular architecture featuring a secure cloud infrastructure and an API-first connectivity suite for seamless integrations with core banking systems and SWIFT.
The company reports that its flagship TradeZone platform supports straight-through transaction processing using APIs and integrates with both in-house and cloud-based banking applications.

The company reports a future-ready product roadmap that incorporates blockchain-enabled smart contract settlements for trade finance, explainable AI for compliance decisions, and embedded low-code development tools.
CSB Bank Ltd partnered with Kyzer Software in July 2023 to digitize and automate its internal trade finance operations using the TradeZone workflow platform.
RBL Bank went live with Kyzer Software's trade finance automation solutions in August 2017, and NKGSB Bank deployed the TradeZone platform in August 2018.
Kyzer Software India Private Limited reported an annual revenue of ₹7.17 Cr for fiscal year 2024, representing a 3.00% year-on-year growth rate.
claims.note: The exact year-on-year growth rate of 3.00% could not be verified in published sources.

claims.claim: Regulatory registry corporate filings show that Kyzer Software India Private Limited generated less than ₹10 Cr in revenue for the financial year ending on March 31, 2025, with a compounded annual growth rate of -19% over the preceding year.
The company reports its corporate headquarters in Mumbai, India, where its primary support and engineering resources manage products deployed across more than 16 Indian and multinational banks.
claims.note: The deployment metric across 'more than 16' banks could not be verified in published sources.

claims.claim: In July 2025, the company announced an expansion of its global footprint backed by a planned £10 million investment over three years to establish operations and a team in London, UK, which is officially registered at 124 City Road.
Kyzer Software India Pvt Ltd is a private unlisted company incorporated in August 2016 with a paid-up capital of Rs. 100,000.00.
The company reports having over 100 client implementations, more than 5 multinational banks, and over 22 leading banks in India using its platforms.
claims.source: Kyzer Software Corporate Profile Presentation (via Scribd) and Official Website Marketing Materials

claims.claim: Client deployments include live trade finance automation setups at RBL Bank, CSB Bank Ltd., NKGSB Bank, and SVC Bank.
claims.source: Kyzer Software Official Site Case Studies, Press Releases, Media Coverage Page, and Client Testimonials
